# Overview

This is a direct port of the retail **[RCLootCouncil](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil)** addon with certain elements modified to fit within the Classic environment. This means this version can always be (mostly) up to date with the latest features added to the main addon. For the retail version and description, see the original **[RCLootCouncil](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil)** addon.

### Wiki

The [RCLootCouncil Wiki](https://github.
com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki) contains all the information you may need to use the addon, along with examples of specific use cases and is up to date with the Classic version. Do check it out!

### Bugtracking

Create an issue [here on Curseforge](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-classic/issues/create) , and make sure to follow the description.

### Support

Head on over to the [RCLootCouncil Discord](https://www.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=http%253a%252f%252fdiscord.rclootcouncil.com%252f) if you have any questions. I rarely read Curseforge comments!

For bug reports you can alternatively [use the Curse issue tracking](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil/issues/create) [](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/rclootcouncil/issues/create) or if you're on [Github](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/issues) that's even better! I much prefer to keep all of it on Discord though.

## WoW Classic

Head over to the [**RCLootCouncil Classic**](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/rclootcouncil-classic/) page for more info.

In case the item does end up with someone else, either have them trade it to the leader, or have them manually trade it to the winner, or re-add the item with the looters name (e.g. `/rc add LootersName [item]` ) to make it work with the TradeUI.

## Features

Every last detail of **RCLootCouncil** is also described in [the Wiki](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki) !

Loot Council automatization  
Automatically starts a loot session with any tradable items looted by raiders. Shows the VotingFrame for council members and LootFrame for other raiders

Fully implemented loot frame  
No need to link your items, **RCLootCouncil** comes with an automatic system for looting, where raiders can indicate their choice to the council.

Customizeable council  
You decide who's council, whether based on guild rank or custom added members, all with a nice and simple interface. You can also run a solo council just by yourself to easily distribute tradeable items.

Automated display

...

In case someone in your raid haven't installed the addon (not recommended) just tell them to whisper their item(s) the loot would replace to the master looter, and the addon will extract as much data from it as it can. Whispers is enabled by default. See the "Whispers" section for more details.

## Usage

If you're new to **RCLootCouncil** you should definitely read up on the [**Getting Started**](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki) part of the wiki. Below is a short introduction:

The raid leader is prompted with a confirmation to use the addon upon entering a raid. When accepted, the addon is watching all tradable items looted, finds the council and activate their addon as well. If the group leader haven't set a council, he's prompted to do so. Use "/rc council" to open the council interface.

## Description

**RCLootCouncil** is an addon intended to facilitate and speed up the loot council process - something that still exists even though Blizzard has forced Personal Loot upon us all. It's a tool that can be used in many ways, but for the vast majority of users it's all about clicking their response in the Loot Frame .

This is a direct port of the retail **RCLootCouncil** addon with certain elements modified to fit within the Classic environment (see Changes below). This means this version can always be (mostly) up to date with the latest features added to the main addon.

More info on the commands : [Wiki\_RCLootCouncil](https://github.com/evil-morfar/RCLootCouncil2/wiki)
